claims.reasoning: The residue-constant ring C=k+m_A has maximal ideal exactly m_A and m_C^N=m_A^N for every N>=1, including the multiplication argument t^N a=t^(N-1)(ta). Closedness gives the required completeness. Finiteness of the original residue field makes k_A/k finite; recursive t-adic expansions make A a finite k[[t]]-module, and C is a finite submodule. The field case is separated. This proves the full IsCO specialization actually needed for every original IsCD test ring.
